To the King my lord, my sun, my god, the breath of my life...
your slave and dust under your feet.  At the feet of the King my

seven times.  I heard the words of the tablets of the King my lord,
my sun, my god, the breath of my life, and the heat of your slave and the 
dust under the feet of the King, my lord, my sun, my god, the breath of 
my life, is exceeing glad that the breath of the King my lord, my sun, my 
god has gone out to his slave and to the dust under his fee.
